notes: German calendar words. months: name → month number, with the ae spelling of ä; monthAbbreviations: the usual short forms ('15. Nov.'). seasons, weekParts and holidays anchor a point in time ('im Sommer', 'zu Ostern'). Weekdays are in clauseWordClasses.json. hourWords: the unit of a time of day ('9 Uhr', '14 h'). dayParts: parts of the day that name a time together with a number ('morgens um 9'), each with the hours it spans [from, to] on the 24-hour clock ('nacht' runs past midnight), so 'abends um 8' is 20:00.
